get.description: Paged processed Parquet discovery for [from, to). Request pages pin one committed catalog generation, excluding uncommitted uploads and replaced representations. Summary selection uses a fully covered day bundle, otherwise hour bundles and uncovered late window summaries, with finer windows at partial boundaries. Incremental requests replay bounded raw changes and replace marked summary-day selections; apply all pages atomically. A cursor can continue through an empty page. complete is true only on the last page.

parameters.name: since_generation
parameters.description: Request committed changes since this request-catalog generation. Requires previous_from and previous_to. All pages pin one target generation; expired replay, retention or reset requires a full resynchronization.

parameters.name: previous_from
parameters.description: Start of the previously applied complete catalog range.

parameters.name: previous_to
parameters.description: End of the previously applied complete catalog range.

parameters.name: summaries
parameters.description: Include committed chart summaries on every page.

schema.description: raw (default) lists window Parquet files; summary lists summary files (request dataset only).

files.description: Full snapshot entries, or entering-range snapshot entries for an incremental response.

summary_files.description: Coarsest nonoverlapping committed summaries. In incremental responses these replace the cached summaries for summary_partitions, evaluated against the new whole query range.

base_generation.description: Previously applied generation used by an incremental response.

changes.description: Ordered committed raw-file changes after base_generation. Stage every page before applying replacements and additions atomically.

summary_partitions.description: Authoritative UTC-day summary reset ranges. Clear cached summaries for each marked day before installing summary_files; an empty marked day clears its previous summaries. Omitted days remain unchanged.

catalog_generation.description: Committed request catalog snapshot pinned by every page of this listing.

approximate.description: view=summary only: summary format version and which values are approximate (top-K truncation with __other__, HLL distinct counts, capped IP samples).

409.description: Catalog snapshot or replay expired, or lineage changed. Restart with a full snapshot.

503.description: Catalog unavailable or the observed head is behind the requested generation. Retry without regressing the applied generation.

ErrorDetail.title: ErrorDetail
ErrorDetail.description:
Inner detail object for the canonical error envelope.

Allows extra fields because a handful of historical 403 sites attach
context (``service``, ``invite_id``, etc.) alongside the canonical
``error`` code. Locking the shape down would force a coordinated
rewrite of those handlers without changing observable behavior — the
frontend's ``extractApiError`` already keys on ``detail.error`` and
ignores extras.

LogExtentsResponse.title: LogExtentsResponse
LogExtentsResponse.description:
Minimal extents projection for the FilterBar's time-range snap.

Sibling of ``SyncStatusResponse`` but strips every field that the
middleware blocks ``/api/sync-status`` for an analyst over: no
``ngwaf_workspace_id``, no ``active_run``, no cron task state, no
DuckDB size, no storage mode. Just the two timestamps the
FilterBar needs to snap its range, plus a ``configured`` flag so
the frontend can short-circuit when a service has no source.
